```
A project is a repository and the shape of the workspace that opens it: the image, the preset
and the network policies, and the ref it opens at. 'spin workspace create --project <slug>' makes a
workspace of that shape, whose guest clones the repository into /workspace/<repository name> once
you approve its settings, and runs the repository's own .spin.yaml tasks there.

Projects are the installation's. Whoever makes one is its admin, and it is seen by everybody until
its admins share it with only some people and teams ('spin project share'). A private repository
on GitHub is cloned with the workspace owner's own GitHub account, connected in the dashboard
(Settings → Git); the URL carries no credential.

Usage:
  spin project [flags]
  spin project [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Make a project
  delete      Delete a project; one with a workspace open on it is refused
  list        List the projects you see
  prebuild    Build one of a project's prebuild refs now
  prebuilds   List a project's prebuilds, newest first
  share       Say who sees a project and who administers it, whole
  update      Save a project whole: every flag is what it becomes

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for project

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use; SPIN_PROFILE names it when this flag does not (default "default")

Use "spin project [command] --help" for more information about a command.
```

### spin project create

```
Make a project: its repository, the ref it opens at, and the shape of the workspace that opens
it. You are its admin, and everybody sees it until you share it otherwise. An installation may keep
making projects to its administrators.

Example:
  spin project create --name qboot --repository https://github.com/spin-stack/qboot --ref master --preset large

Usage:
  spin project create [flags]

Flags:
      --description string            A line about it
  -h, --help                          help for create
      --image string                  The image a workspace of it starts from (default: the installation's)
      --name string                   What the project is called
      --network-tag strings           A network policy a workspace of it runs under, by name (repeatable)
      --prebuild-rebase-every int32   Every how many builds of a ref one is built from the image again (default: 10)
      --prebuild-ref stringArray      A ref it prebuilds: built as it moves, and what opening the project at it is cloned from (repeatable; the builds run as you)
      --preset string                 The preset a workspace of it is sized by (default: the installation's)
      --ref string                    The branch or tag a workspace opens at unless the open names one
      --repository string             The repository's https URL, with no credential in it
      --slug string                   What it is named by in the installation (made from the name if empty)

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use; SPIN_PROFILE names it when this flag does not (default "default")
```

### spin project prebuild

```
Build one of a project's prebuild refs now, at the commit its forge says it is at, rather than at
the next look (every five minutes): a commit whose build failed is built again. The project's
admins only. Answered with the build, or the one of that commit already building or ready.

Usage:
  spin project prebuild <slug> <ref> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for prebuild

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use; SPIN_PROFILE names it when this flag does not (default "default")
```

### spin project prebuilds

```
List a project's prebuilds: each build of one of its prebuild refs at a commit, what became of it,
and the snapshot opening the project at that ref is cloned from once it is ready. A ready one is
what its host signed it to be; spin shows that claim, and holds it to its own anchors, when a
workspace opened from it asks you to approve its settings.

Usage:
  spin project prebuilds <slug> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for prebuilds

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use; SPIN_PROFILE names it when this flag does not (default "default")
```

### spin project share

```
Say who sees a project and who administers it: everybody (--everyone), or the people (--user,
by id) and teams (--team, by id, path or me) named; and its admins (--admin, by id), at least one,
who always see it. What is not named is no longer shared. Its admins only.

Example:
  spin project share qboot --team /engineering --admin 0190c1f2-0000-7000-8000-000000000001

Usage:
  spin project share <slug> [flags]

Flags:
      --admin stringArray   A person who administers it, by id (repeatable; at least one)
      --everyone            Everybody signed in sees it
  -h, --help                help for share
      --team stringArray    A team whose members see it, by id, path or me (repeatable)
      --user stringArray    A person who sees it, by id (repeatable)

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use; SPIN_PROFILE names it when this flag does not (default "default")
```

### spin project update

```
Save a project whole: what each flag says is what the project becomes, and a flag not given
is the field emptied, since a project is saved as a form shows it. Its admins only. A workspace
already open keeps what it was opened with.

Usage:
  spin project update <slug> [flags]

Flags:
      --description string            A line about it
  -h, --help                          help for update
      --image string                  The image a workspace of it starts from (default: the installation's)
      --name string                   What the project is called
      --network-tag strings           A network policy a workspace of it runs under, by name (repeatable)
      --prebuild-rebase-every int32   Every how many builds of a ref one is built from the image again (default: 10)
      --prebuild-ref stringArray      A ref it prebuilds: built as it moves, and what opening the project at it is cloned from (repeatable; the builds run as you)
      --preset string                 The preset a workspace of it is sized by (default: the installation's)
      --ref string                    The branch or tag a workspace opens at unless the open names one
      --repository string             The repository's https URL, with no credential in it
      --slug string                   What it is named by in the installation (made from the name if empty)

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use; SPIN_PROFILE names it when this flag does not (default "default")
```
